name: Silver Dawning's Lockbox
summary: Off the Darkshore coast, Silver Dawning's Lockbox lies in a wreck north of Auberdine. Coastal murlocs sank the ship, and the box holds its captain's personal effects and ship log.

sections.title: Sunken Remnants
sections.body: The Silver Dawning was sailing toward Auberdine when coastal murlocs attacked. They drove the ship beneath the waves north of the harbor, and the captain died in the assault. The flooded hull still holds the captain's lockbox, with the ship's log and private belongings inside. Recovering them may bring some peace to the surviving crew ashore.

faq.q: Where is the Silver Dawning's Lockbox located?
faq.answer: The lockbox rests inside the submerged wreck of the Silver Dawning, on the ocean floor north of Auberdine off the Darkshore coast.

faq.q: What happened to the Silver Dawning?
faq.answer: Coastal murlocs attacked the Silver Dawning as it sailed toward Auberdine. They overwhelmed the ship, and it sank beneath the waves with its captain.
The lockbox holds the Silver Dawning captain's personal effects and sea log.
Gorbold Steelhand, a dwarf stationed in Auberdine, asks swimmers to retrieve the lockbox from the wrecks so the fallen captain's surviving crew can honor their memory.

angles.text: The lockbox holds the final writings and belongings of a kaldorei captain who died defending their vessel off the shores of northern Kalimdor.
Gorbold Steelhand takes it upon himself to honor the fallen captains and return their belongings to their surviving mates.
